answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university, which includes the senate.
The president leads the university leadership which sets the frame and the budget.
The president does not have a defined role in faculty-specific appointment committees according to the rules.
The president leads the whole university rather than sitting in individual faculty councils.
The study commission is a faculty-level body and the president deals with central matters.
The examination board handles faculty-specific student matters where the president does not participate.
The internal research funding round is an internal faculty matter.
The module revision working group operates at the degree programme level, not the central leadership level.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled at the faculty or working level, not by the president.
Orientation week planning is an activity outside the central leadership duties.
